### Back port request
- [ ] 201911

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Multiple drop_packets test fail on dual ToR testbeds

#### How did you do it?
- Apply any configurations/ACLs/etc. to all ToRs in a testbed
- When sending traffic from server to ToR, use the VLAN MAC when available instead of the switch MAC
